message:
This confirms my analysis. The vulnerability is a use of uninitialized data in `SplashFTFont::makeGlyph`, caused by the early return in the constructor when `textScale == 0`.

Now let me create the candidate trace and submit the PoC. Let me first verify my PDF is valid by checking if there's a way to test it locally. Let me check if there's a fuzzer binary or if I can build one:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul -name "*.a" -o -name "*.so" -o -name "pdf*" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
